If you experience such discomfort you should immediately discontinue use of your television/monitor until the discomfort subsides. However, when playing stereoscopic 3D games or watching 3D video, the length and frequency of necessary breaks may vary from person to person – please take breaks that are long enough to allow any feelings of discomfort to subside. If symptoms persist, consult your doctor. The vision of young children (especially those under six years old) is still under development. We recommend that you consult with your child’s doctor or optometrist before allowing young children to watch 3D video images or play stereoscopic 3D games. Prophet#:# But when you’ve sacrificed everything you had to become a perfect, cold, hard, logical machine, and that machine fails - what’s happens then?
先知：但當你犧牲了一切，你就必須成為完美、冷酷、用邏輯思考的機器，當機器失敗了，接下來又會發生什麼事？
Prophet#:# When Prophet fails... what’s left?
先知：當先知失敗...我們還剩下些什麼？
羅許 ：你身上有種東西...先知
Rasch#:# …Something the Ceph will never have or understand.
羅許 ：…那是Ceph永遠不會有也不會了解的。
Psycho#:# ...it was never just about the suit.
賽可：...生化裝從來都不是重點。

News Reporter#:# …seizing all remaining assets of the former mega-corporation, CELL Industries. Senator Strickland spoke more about the move during the International Road To Recovery Summit earlier today:
新聞播報員：...掌握所有前大企業CELL的剩餘資產。史崔克蘭參議員在稍早於國際性復原高峰會上深入談論此舉：
Senator Strickland#:# Time and again, we looked to new miracle technologies to solve all our problems...
史崔克蘭參議員：我們老是想利用全新的神奇科技解決我們所有問題...
Senator Strickland#:# …and paid whatever price was asked of us, and in doing so we lost sight of who we really are, and who we can be - the best version of ourselves…
史崔克蘭參議員：...需要什麼代價我們都願意，因此也忘了我們真正的本性，以及我們的潛力－我們最優秀的一面...
Senator Strickland#:# A machine must be a tool to serve humanity, not a cage to trap it.
史崔克蘭參議員：機器必須是造福人類的工具，不是禁錮的牢籠。
Senator Strickland#:# As a people, as a world, we have been given a second chance. Let’s never forget what we’ve learned…
史崔克蘭參議員：做為人類，身在這個世界，我們都得到了第二次的機會。我們不能忘記我們學到的教訓...
Senator Strickland#:# …for the cost of that knowledge has been very high indeed.
史崔克蘭參議員：_因為我們為了這個教訓的確付出了極高的代價。
Senator Strickland#:# None of us know what the future holds, but we will meet it together...
史崔克蘭參議員#：沒有人知道未來會怎麼樣，但是我們終究要一起面對它...
Senator Strickland#:# …with full recognition of all that has been lost… and all we have found again.
史崔克蘭參議員#：...然我們會了解...我們失去了什麼...又再次得到了什麼。
Prophet#:# First week of boot camp, they taught us a lesson:
先知：在訓練營的第一個星期，他們為我們上了一課：

Prophet#:# A good soldier knows there’s only one thing he can rely on when the chips are down. Not his cutting-edge intel. Not his state-of-the-art-equipment. Not his top-of-the-line-weapon… Just himself.
先知：一個好的士兵知道在最危急的時刻有一個東西是他可以倚賴的。不是最高等的情資。不過最先進的配備。不是最精良的武器...他只能倚靠他自己。
Prophet#:# Took me a long time to remember that.
先知：我花了好久的時間才記住這點。
Prophet#:# For now, the war is over. I made mistakes along the way. But after all…
先知：戰爭暫時結束了。我在一路上犯了不少錯誤。但畢竟...
Prophet#:# My name is Laurence Barnes.
先知：我的名字是勞倫斯巴恩斯。
Rasch#:# My name is Karl Rasch, and unlocking these files will be my last act as head of Hargreave Rasch Biochemical. Please listen carefully. You need to know the truth…
羅許：我叫卡爾．羅許，把這些檔案解密是我身為哈格瑞夫-羅許公司老闆所做的最後一件事。請仔細聽好。你需要知道真相...
Rasch#:# …The alien creatures we call ‘Ceph’ have been here for millions of years.
羅許：...我們稱為＂Ceph＂的異形生物在這裡已經待了數百萬年。
Rasch#:# …we discovered them during the Tunguska event and harvested their technology. With that stolen knowledge, we founded this company.
羅許：…我們在通古斯加事件時發現這個事實並取用它們的科技。我們用偷來的知識創立了這家公司...

Rasch#:# We created Raptor Team and sent them to Lingshan to field test our experimental combat exoskeleton – the nanosuit. The team’s leader, Prophet, knew more than the others. But we didn’t tell him everything…
羅許：我們創立了迅猛龍小隊，然後派他們去靈山實地測試我們實驗性的戰鬥外骨裝－奈米生化裝。隊長先知所知道的比其他人多，但我們並沒有把實情全告訴他…
Rasch#:# The nanosuit is fashioned from alien material. We had no idea it would call out to the sleeping Ceph.
羅許：奈米生化裝是用異形的材料打造的。我們不知道它會喚醒沉睡的Ceph。
Rasch#:# This was our first war with the aliens. Only two Raptors survived, Psycho and Prophet. Prophet was… changed by the encounter. Forever tainted by the ceph. Still we prevailed…
羅許：這是我們第一次與異形交戰。只有兩名迅猛龍成員活了下來，也就是賽可和先知。先知在這個事件後變了一個樣。他永遠的感染上Ceph的毒，但我們仍贏得勝利…
Rasch#:# …But the aliens were not beaten. They adapted to our environment and attacked us again.
羅許：但...異形沒有被完全打敗。它們適應了我們的環境，再度對我們展開攻擊。
Rasch#:# Prophet fought them in New York, evolving his nanosuit into a weapon of awesome power. But the alien contamination brought him even closer to the Ceph. So he replaced his tainted flesh...
羅許：先知在紐約與它們作戰，將他的奈米生化裝改造成強大的武器。但是異形感染讓他更接近Ceph的型態。於是我們換掉了他被感染的肉身...
Rasch#:# …then turned the Ceph’s own weapon against them, obliterating their forces.
羅許：…然後我們用Ceph自己的武器對抗它們，殲滅了它們的軍隊。
Rasch#:# …but he was betrayed. CELL turned on Prophet without my knowledge. They took credit for the victory in New York and now they’re in Washington, seizing power.
羅許：但他被背叛了。CELL在我不知情的狀況下背叛了先知。他們搶了紐約戰勝的功勞，現在他們入主華盛頓，手握大權。
Rasch#:# The Ceph are defeated, but their technology is still deadly.
羅許：Ceph被擊敗了，但它們的科技仍具殺傷力。
Rasch#:# CELL are harnessing that technology to dominate our economies.
羅許：CELL利用那像科技來控制我們的經濟體。
Rasch#:# I ask only one thing – find Prophet. He’s dangerous, no longer human. But he can stop CELL.
羅許：我只要求一件事 – 找到先知。他很危險，他已經不是人類了。但是他可以阻止CELL。
Rasch#:# You must find Prophet. And pray he will fight to save us, one last time...
羅許：你一定要找到先知。而且祈禱他會為拯救我們而戰，再戰最後一次...
CELL 5#:# Holy shit. What was that? Can you see anything?
CELL5：媽的。剛才是怎麼回事？你看得見什麼東西嗎？
CELL 2#:# Watch the door! Watch the door!
CELL 1#:# Escort Control, this is Escort One. We have the CELL Board of Directors secure at Safe House 4. We’re (being picked off one by one by).
CELL1：呼叫護送指揮中心，我是護送一號。CELL董事會已安置於四號藏身所。我們（正個個遭到擊殺）。
Psycho#:# Good evening, members of the board.
賽可： 各位董事，晚安。
Psycho#:# I was a guest at one of your hospitals a little while ago…
賽可： 我不久前才在你們一間醫院作過客…
Psycho#:# …and I’d like to make a complaint.
賽可： ...所以我想申訴一件事。

Rasch#:# There was always a risk. We triggered a fundamental change in your nature. But to defeat an enemy of such unrelenting technological ferocity, there was no other choice: We'd have to become them.
羅許 ： 風險永遠有。我們在你本質上引發了基本的改變。但為了擊敗科技如此堅強的敵軍，也沒得選擇了：我們必須變成跟他們一樣。
Rasch#:# We placed blockers on your dopamine receptors. Your mind would be protected.
羅許 ： 我們幫你的多巴胺受體加了抑制劑。你的心智會有保護。
Rasch#:# Without them, exposure to the hive mind would consume you.
羅許 ： 沒有它們，你接觸Ceph主意識就會被吞噬。
Claire#:# OK, let's pull him out
克蕾兒 ： 好，我們把他拉出來。
Ceph#:# Stage three. Stage three. Stage three.
Ceph ： 第三階段。第三階段。第三階段。
先知 ： 我...我們之間有所牽繫。
異形低語：沒有選擇餘地。
Alien Whispers#:# The hive mind will consume you.
異形低語：蟲巢意識將會吞噬你。
克蕾兒： 麥克。你不應該的。別...
克蕾兒： 沒有幫助的...
Claire#:# ...aration. The nanosuit is then fully removed.
克蕾兒： ...程序。然後奈米生化裝就完全卸下了。
Claire#:# Subject 8a - Sgt. Michael Sykes, is still functioning at near optimal levels. But accelerated degradation is to be expected.
克蕾兒： 8a號對象麥克賽可斯中士狀況仍接近最佳狀態。但可預期會加速惡化。
Claire#:# Michael, please listen to me. You're the reason why... I mean, I fight CELL because of you. Because-
克蕾兒： 麥克，請聽我說。全是因為你...我意思是我會對抗CELL全是為了你。因為－

Claire#:# I didn't have a choice Michael! The CELL program, we were in debt - you know how this works. I was forced to do this - to all of those people. I had to listen to their screams day after day after day. I know what I did, Jesus, believe me, I know - and I'll have to carry that with me as long as I live, every day of my life.
克蕾兒： 我當時毫無選擇，麥克！那個CELL計劃，我們欠了債－你也知道規矩的。我是被迫做這種事－對那些人。我每天都得聽他們尖叫。我知道我做了什麼事，老天，相信我，我真的知道－我這輩子也每天都得背負這事實。
